product.name: Jin AI
product.headline: Turn AI into a company asset
product.description: Turn AI into a company asset. Keep confidential data in, see how each role uses AI, and hand the best harnesses to colleagues and successors.
product.harness_definition: An AI harness is the instructions, skills, memory and connected tools around an AI agent that make it work for a role.
product.availability: The workspace beta is live. Company features are being built, starting with Claude Code.

problem.headline: AI is everywhere now. Is it really set up to last?

points.name: Shadow AI
points.description: Work context flows into personal AI tools, outside the company's control.

points.name: Agents that depend on one person
points.description: Agents, context and workflows live with whoever built them. When that person leaves, the agents stop and the successor starts over.

points.name: Skills stuck in one team
points.description: One team finds what works. The rest of the company never sees it.

solution.headline: How Jin AI keeps your AI

steps.name: Keep it safe
steps.description: Confidential parts stay inside the company and connect only to the AI tools you approve.

steps.name: Keep it in the company
steps.description: Agents, context and workflows stay with the role, not the person. A successor starts where the last person left off.

steps.name: Keep it shared
steps.description: The best skills reach every team that does the same work.

solution.closing: As people improve their setups, Jin AI keeps the shared version up to date.

how_it_works.introduction: Connect once, see every part, and Jin AI keeps each team's shared harness up to date.

features.name: Connect once
features.description: Connect your usual AI tools once, through MCP.

features.name: See every part by type
features.description: Skills, prompts, memory and MCP settings, sorted by type.

features.name: See what each team uses most
features.description: See which harnesses each department uses most.

features.name: Separate personal from company
features.description: Keep what came from personal AI apart from parts that hold confidential company context.

features.name: Control approved AI tools
features.description: Let people use only the tools you approve. For example: Claude Code for developers only, your company policy in Copilot, and only non-confidential parts in ChatGPT.

data_principles.headline: Your company's context stays yours
items: Each company's context is kept separate.
Jin AI never records your screen.
Jin AI itself never trains on your data.

capabilities.name: Connect once
capabilities.description: Jin AI connects to your AI tools through MCP.

capabilities.name: See every harness by category
capabilities.description: Skills, instructions, memory and MCP settings, sorted for each person.

capabilities.name: See it by role
capabilities.description: Which harnesses each role uses, and how often.

capabilities.name: Decide what can move
capabilities.description: Parts marked confidential connect only to the AI tools you approve.

founders.name: Yu Asano
founders.bio: Four years of B2B SaaS go-to-market for Microsoft 365 and Azure. Built Jin AI's beta solo.

direct_answers.question: What is Jin AI?
direct_answers.answer: Turn AI into a company asset. Keep confidential data in, see how each role uses AI, and hand the best harnesses to colleagues and successors.

direct_answers.question: What is an AI harness?
direct_answers.answer: An AI harness is the instructions, skills, memory and connected tools around an AI agent that make it work for a role.

direct_answers.question: Is Jin AI available now?
direct_answers.answer: The workspace beta is live. Company features are being built, starting with Claude Code.

direct_answers.question: Which AI tools does it work with?
direct_answers.answer: Claude Code first. Other AI tools are next.

direct_answers.question: Where does the data live?
direct_answers.answer: Jin AI keeps each company's context separate.

direct_answers.question: How is this different from banning AI tools?
direct_answers.answer: Banning AI tools also removes the harnesses that work. Jin AI keeps confidential data in and lets the company reuse what works.
